::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [4 January 1895]  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: MS English Letters: e.174 ff 158[^1]
:::

[To the [Rev. J. F. W. Bullock](people/person_221.qmd)]

<u>wold</u> is the termination[.] Canon Benham’s [Diocesan Chronicle](other_books/otherbook_704.qmd) calls him Athelwold[^2]

C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Postcard addressed to ‘Revd  JFW Bullock/ Radwinter Rectory/ Saffron Walden/ Essex.’ Postmark JA 4/95.
[^2]: This answer presumably relates to a query posed by Bullock in connection with his *Daily Lections*, to which CMY was contributing some of the 'Biographies of Eminent Anglicans'.
